briefdescription.para: Color of major tick marks. Default: Qt::black.
Optional color of tick labels. When invalid, the tickColor is used.
Target number of major tick marks. Actual count is adjusted for "nice" values. Default: 5.
Number of sub-tick intervals between adjacent major ticks. Default: 10.
Convenience setter for both tickLengthIn and tickLengthOut simultaneously.
Convenience setter for both subtickLengthIn and subtickLengthOut simultaneously.
Length in pixels of the portion of a major tick that extends into the plot area. Default: 8.
Length in pixels of the portion of a major tick that extends outside the plot area. Default: 8.
Inward length in pixels of sub-tick marks. Default: 4.
Outward length in pixels of sub-tick marks. Default: 4.
Color of sub-tick marks. Default: Qt::darkGray.
Width in pixels of major tick mark lines. Default: 2.
Width in pixels of sub-tick mark lines. Default: 1.
Spacing in pixels between a tick mark and its label. Default: 5.
Rotation angle in degrees applied to each tick label. Default: 0.
Font used to render tick labels. Default: application default font.
Optional custom formatter for tick labels. When nullptr the default NumericTickLabelFormatter is used.
Constructs an AxisTicker with the given parent.
Returns the major tick color.
Sets the major tick color to c.
Returns the tick-label color, or an invalid color when it follows tickColor.
Sets the tick-label color to c. An invalid color restores the tickColor fallback.
Returns the target number of major ticks.
Sets the target major tick count to count.
Returns the sub-tick interval count.
Sets the sub-tick interval count to count.
Returns the shared inward+outward tick length (reads tickLengthIn).
Sets both tickLengthIn and tickLengthOut to length.
Returns the shared inward+outward sub-tick length (reads subtickLengthIn).
Sets both subtickLengthIn and subtickLengthOut to length.
Returns the inward major tick length.
Sets the inward major tick length to length.
Returns the outward major tick length.
Sets the outward major tick length to length.
Returns the inward sub-tick length.
Sets the inward sub-tick length to length.
Returns the outward sub-tick length.
Sets the outward sub-tick length to length.
Returns the sub-tick color.
Sets the sub-tick color to c.
Returns the major tick line width.
Sets the major tick line width to width.
Returns the sub-tick line width.
Sets the sub-tick line width to width.
Returns the tick label padding.
Sets the tick label padding to padding.
Returns the tick label rotation in degrees.
Sets the tick label rotation to rotation degrees.
Returns the tick label font.
Sets the tick label font to f.
Returns the custom tick label formatter, or nullptr if using the default.
Sets the tick label formatter to formatter.

Controls the visual appearance of ticks, sub-ticks, and tick labels on an Axis.

detaileddescription.para: Accessible via the Axis::ticker CONSTANT property. Changes are applied on the next paint event.
